$comment: The FIXED rules page-lab-gate runs after every navigation (docs/page-lab-vnext-design.md §7.3). Data, not code: scripts/lib/gate.mjs#decide reads this file and nothing else decides whether a page is a challenge. Order is precedence — status, then headers, then final-url, then title, then probe; the first rule that fires names the stop. Every rule's name is a slug that ends up in page-lab/block@1 evidence.rule, so a name must match ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]*$ and must never carry page text. Bump version on any change; tests/gate-decide.test.mjs pins each rule to a fixture. A detector that cannot read its signal does not pass the page — it STOPS with reason detector-error.

headers.$comment: Read from get_network_request on the main document. --redactNetworkHeaders (a MUST in the closed argv) replaces cf-mitigated and cf-ray VALUES with "<redacted>" but keeps the KEY (measured, 1.12.0) — so a rule tests PRESENCE. Cloudflare sends cf-mitigated only as "challenge". Only the allowlisted headers ever reach evidence; set-cookie never does [F-REDACTED-HEADERS-KEEP-KEYS].

finalUrl.$comment: A 3xx never shows in list_network_requests (measured: a 302 to /login lists only the 200 /login), so a redirect is caught by WHERE the browser ended up, not by a status [F-NAV-SUCCESS-ON-403]. A login path counts only when the requested URL was not itself one.

title.name: title-cf-checking
title.pattern: checking (if the site connection is secure|your browser)

probe.$comment: One fixed evaluate_script function, built from these selectors by lib/gate.mjs#probeSource. A hit needs a RENDERED element (getClientRects non-empty), except script/iframe markers, which count on presence: a challenge iframe whose load the allowlist blocked still names the challenge. The probe returns only rule names, never markup. A rule marked corroborate counts ONLY when the page is otherwise suspect — main-document status >= corroboration.minStatus, or a corroboration header present (a challenge title stops on its own first). Measured false positive: Cloudflare injects /cdn-cgi/challenge-platform/scripts/jsd/main.js (a beacon) into NORMAL 200 pages, so no script src is a marker at all, and a bare widget on a 200 page (a login form's captcha) is not a wall.

rules.name: age-gate
rules.selector: [id*="age-gate" i], [class*="age-gate" i], [id*="agegate" i], [class*="agegate" i], [id*="age-verif" i], [class*="age-verif" i]
